slots.name: parliament seats
slots.sentence: Latvia elects its 100-seat parliament, Saeima, through proportional representation, meaning coalition governments are the norm.

slots.name: defense spending
slots.sentence: Latvia is one of the few NATO members that have committed by law to spending 5% of GDP on defense, and analysts say the country's foreign policy orientation is unlikely to change regardless of which coalition emerges after the vote as there is nearly unanimous consensus on the importance of NATO.

slots.name: election date
slots.sentence: ahead of the country's elections on October 3.
